page.overview:
Who is Desaund?

is an archivist working in the Rexxentrum Archive of the Cobalt Soul. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

is a male half-elf of undetermined age but young-ish. His hair is cut extremely short, and his eyes are a dull amber color.

Desaund was the archivist assigned to Caduceus when he researched The Traveler while in Rexxentrum, finding recent references in books of rural hearsay of neo-religions and folklore.
